mapper.select: SELECT b.realname AS name, c.comment_id AS id, c.parent_comment_id AS pid, c.user_id AS uid, c.content AS content, (select count(*) from r_user_like_comment where comment_id = c.comment_id and flag = 1) as cal_like_num, c.like_number AS thumb, c.create_time AS date, bu.realname AS rname, CASE WHEN (select count(*) from r_user_like_comment where comment_id = c.comment_id and flag = 1 and user_id = #{userId}) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS status FROM cms_comment c LEFT JOIN b_user b ON c.user_id = b.user_id LEFT JOIN cms_comment c1 ON c.parent_comment_id = c1.comment_id LEFT JOIN b_user bu ON c1.user_id = bu.user_id ORDER BY c.create_time
